description: One saved flow (Page Flows → Saved flows): its details, its diagram (plain English or technical), an editor (reword steps, notes, steps and actions added, moved, removed, systems as lanes), comments, its versions (view, restore), a check against the app and its steps run for real (▶ Run on a step, an action or the whole flow, through the API tester); Save (a new version), Save as copy, PDF, SVG, Remove (desktop/lib/savedFlows.js, resources/js/flowModel.js).

flowId.description: The saved flow open in this tab (FL-0001…).

flow.description: The flow as edited (unsaved changes included).

saved.description: The flow as last saved (to tell unsaved changes).

tab.description: flow | edit | details | comments | history | check

plain.description: The flow in plain English (a sentence per step) — for a business reader.

note.description: What changed (kept with the new version).

viewV.description: History: the earlier version shown (0: none).

m.description: The app's scan (lib/integrations.js), read for Check against the app.

runs.description: Steps run for real (▶ Run), by step id: { open, busy, desc (what its call sends, from the API tester), vals, res (its answer, kept short), state, msg }. Not saved with the flow.

runBusy.description: An action's steps (its id) or the whole flow ('flow') being run.

runSum.description: What the last Run of an action or of the flow did, in words.
